description: Search the authenticated user life graph. Optional from/to (aliases start/end) are inclusive account-local civil dates on every search route; either bound may be used alone. Dated semantic and keyword records use event date, expense date, goal start date, check-in date, or the account-local creation date of contacts and memories. Deterministic routing first: food or relative dates (e.g. "what did I eat yesterday?"); timeline/current-context; money+person; who-is → resolve_person. Otherwise semantic/keyword search. Event hits include event_date and food_id when mirrored from Food Diary. Browser-history titles are excluded. Credential/secret spans are redacted. Records carry inspect_url (their Dayze page): cite with it, never build a link from an id; a record without one has no page (inspect_note says which). Requires OAuth or a supported scoped credential. ($0.15; API key required)

entity_type.description: Route a Moment query to search_moments.

from.description: Inclusive account-local YYYY-MM-DD lower bound for all search routes. May be used alone.

to.description: Inclusive account-local YYYY-MM-DD upper bound for all search routes. May be used alone.

name: search

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

inspect_note.description: How to cite: link each record with its inspect_url, never a link built from an id; which record types here have no Dayze page.

inspect_url.description: PHI-434: the Dayze page for this record, when it has one.

photo_url.description: Meal photo on a food result, when one is attached.

title: Semantic Life Search
